An '''elite waterfiend''' is an [[elite monster|elite version]] of the [[waterfiend]]. If on a [[Slayer assignment]], an elite Waterfiend is guaranteed to spawn; otherwise, elite monsters have a spawn rate of 1 in 1,000. Elite spawn rates can be further increased with the use of [[fellstalk incense stick]]s.
